title: Asmara's Summer
author: Andaleeb Wajid
blurb: Asmara's summer couldn't have been worse. As if her parents leaving her behind on their trip to Canada wasn't enough, she now has to spend her vacation at her Nani's house on Tannery Road. Oh, the horror! What if her college friends discover where she actually lives? Surely, her carefully curated social life would be ruined! Or maybe she'll end up discovering a little more about herself. What do you think? You'll have to read to find out!
